name: Hattush
overview: The name Hattush appears in Scripture as a figure connected with the priestly and Davidic lines, highlighting his role within Israel's religious and genealogical heritage. Ezra 8:2 identifies Hattush as a descendant of David, indicating his royal lineage, while Nehemiah 3:10 and 10:4 mention Hattush in the context of community leadership and priestly service. This dual identification underscores the integration of priestly duties and Davidic descent in the post-exilic community, reflecting the continuity of God's covenant people.
